Specification: This module defines an alternative initial state for a multi-node reads model by extending an existing base specification and adding a new initial predicate. The alternative state initializes ledger branches and history so that two transactions are already committed, as indicated by the comment and by the pre-populated response and committed-status records in the history sequence. The module then defines a temporal specification that starts from this alternative initial state and evolves according to the imported action MCNextMultiNodeReadsAction, using the standard stuttering form [][MCNextMultiNodeReadsAction]_vars.
